description: The state of a judging (queued, working, retrying, done, failed). Retrying: an attempt failed and the queue will try again; stage and error say where. Failed is final (the last attempt failed, or the post is gone) and shows its stage and error. When done: the predictions it logged and the proposals they make. Proposals are never applied while the labeled set has not passed.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
